crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct rectangular red patch is located on the posterior crown and upper nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: The transition boundary is diffuse and low-contrast, showing a continuous gray gradient between the crown and mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast transverse black and white bars are visible across the tail feathers (rectrices).
